Anchor and generation-directory paths are derived from exact scope/generation/controller ID. Both directory witnesses, nonce-bound metadata SHA and fixed marker bytes remain checked. No age takeover, namespace deletion, owner release or old-generation lock reclamation is introduced.

Head CAS, new instance, Session row and grant consumption are in one real writer; consume revalidates the source history with that same connection. Fresh readback confirms current head/row and consumed grant, then Session independently reads its full row. Exceptions retain the private context/namespace and sticky HOLD; best-effort HOLD persistence is not misrepresented as guaranteed.

Old controller ACK/drain and captured pidfd exit precede reservation. Source/request uniqueness and exact pending-head CAS prevent a second successor; SPAWNING commit/readback precede the sole Popen. Uncertain spawn or response is not reset to replayable state. Existing STARTED replay verifies the current captured successor instead of spawning.

Credentialled HELLO/GO/PREPARED/COMMIT/STARTED messages bind actual processes and canonical metadata. PREPARED is not execution permission. Both resource checks occur under context and GPU registry locks, including after COMMIT; first probe/shared loop follows real mark_started. Canonical COMMIT comparison rejects boolean/integer aliasing.

Source ancestry, registration/session/ACK/member digests, terminal/effect receipts and lifecycle projections are bounded and revalidated. Provided connections are borrowed rather than closed/committed; historical observers deliberately bypass current-head selection only for already-bound ancestry and do not capture or signal old PIDs.
